successCriteria.description: Every enum file exists at the specified path with all declared values: LeaveStatus (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED), LeaveType (annual, sick, emergency, unpaid, maternity, paternity), LeaveAction (CREATE, SUBMIT, APPROVE, REJECT, CANCEL, UPDATE, DELETE), NotificationType (LEAVE_SUBMITTED, LEAVE_APPROVED, LEAVE_REJECTED, LEAVE_CANCELLED, BALANCE_UPDATED), EmploymentStatus (ACTIVE, INACTIVE, TERMINATED), AuditAction (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, APPROVE, REJECT).
`src/shared/types/index.ts` barrel-export re-exports every enum from the six individual enum files so that consumers can import all shared types from a single entry point (`shared/types`).

`src/shared/error-types.ts` exports four error classes — NotFoundError, ValidationError, ConflictError, UnauthorizedError — each extending the built-in `Error` and exposing a numeric `statusCode` property (404, 400, 409, 401 respectively).

`src/shared/base-repository.ts` exports a generic `IBaseRepository<T>` interface with methods `findById(id: string): Promise<T | null>`, `findAll(): Promise<T[]>`, `create(entity: Omit<T, 'id'>): Promise<T>`, `update(id: string, entity: Partial<T>): Promise<T | null>`, and `delete(id: string): Promise<boolean>`.

`src/shared/base-repository.ts` exports an abstract `BaseRepository<T>` class that accepts the pg `Pool` from `shared/db/connection` in its constructor and provides concrete implementations of `findById`, `findAll`, `create`, `update`, and `delete` using parameterized SQL queries.
Every repository method on `BaseRepository<T>` accepts an optional `PoolClient` parameter; when provided, the method uses that client instead of the pool, enabling transactional use by callers.

A Jest test file at `tests/unit/shared/types/enums.test.ts` verifies that every enum value exists for all six enums (e.g., `LeaveStatus.DRAFT`, `LeaveType.annual`, `LeaveAction.CREATE`, etc.) and that the barrel index re-exports them.

constraints: All enum files must use TypeScript `const enum` or plain `enum` declarations — no `any` type, no implicit values. The `no-any` constraint from HARNESS.json applies.
The `BaseRepository<T>` must import the `pool` export from `shared/db/connection` using the non-relative import path (baseUrl `./src`). No relative imports like `../../shared/db/connection`.
Test files must use the `.test.ts` extension (not `.spec.ts`) to match the Jest `testMatch` pattern `**/tests/**/*.test.(ts|js)`.

Error classes must extend the built-in `Error` (not a custom base) and expose `statusCode` as a public readonly numeric property. The `message` must be passed through to the `Error` super constructor.

entityInvariants.invariant: The enum values DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED are the only valid states for a LeaveRequest. No other status value may be introduced without updating this enum and all consumers.
The enum values annual, sick, emergency, unpaid, maternity, paternity are the complete set of leave categories. Every LeavePolicy must reference exactly one of these types.
The enum values ACTIVE, INACTIVE, TERMINATED are the only valid employment states. Only ACTIVE employees may submit leave requests; TERMINATED employees are permanently excluded from all workflows.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns the entity or null; never throws for a missing entity. Callers decide whether to throw NotFoundError.
Accepts an entity without `id` (the database assigns it). Returns the created entity including the generated `id`. Must use parameterized queries — no string concatenation of SQL.
Returns `true` if a row was deleted, `false` if no row matched the id. Never throws for a missing entity.
